definitions.gloss: to flash; to flicker; to flutter
definitions.explanation: To flash or flicker briefly, often describing light or something moving quickly.

definitions.gloss: to have a flash of inspiration; to strike (idea)
definitions.explanation: For an idea or thought to suddenly come to mind.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). No pair verb.

WRITING:
Can be written as {閃|ひらめ}く. The kanji {閃|せん} suggests a flash or sparkle.

ASPECT (ている):
- ひらめいた (past) - a sudden flash or inspiration
- ひらめいて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (progressive) - ongoing flickering/fluttering

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひらめく (an idea strikes)
- ⟦{稲妻|いなずま}→稲妻：04989_inazuma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひらめく (lightning flashes)
- ⟦{旗|はた}→旗：02161_hata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひらめく (flag flutters)
- ⟦ひらめき→ひらめき：15779_hirameki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to get inspiration)

RELATED NOUN:
⟦ひらめき→ひらめき：15779_hirameki⟧ - flash of inspiration, brilliance, intuition
- ⟦ひらめき→ひらめき：15779_hirameki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have brilliance/intuition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きらめく→きらめく：07677_kirameku⟧ - to sparkle/glitter (sustained, beautiful)
- ⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧ - to shine (general light emission)
- {思|おも}いつく - to think of/come up with (more deliberate)
